name: Active Loop Picker
author: JC
summary: Pick any stored loop as Active; saved with a red pad when none of yours is lost; auto-advance on exit.
description: Pick which stored loop is the Active Loop, with no playhead jump; it engages by itself when the playhead reaches it. At load the loop marked Active in rekordbox is armed. SHIFT+MEMORY cycles loops ahead. SHIFT+pad on a hot cue loop arms it and, if no loop of yours would be lost, saves it as the track's Active Loop and turns the pad red; SHIFT+the pad again turns it off. The mod only deletes a saved copy it made itself. Reads analysis files read-only. Firmware 2.00/2.01 only. Settings in its Mod Menu page.
